item.title: KOL Views Q&A: Intellia's CRISPR breakthrough will shake up HAE – but not as much as it might have
item.description: FirstWord spoke with Penn State allergist Timothy Craig about Phase III HAELO results for Intellia's lonvo-z, and how the in vivo CRISPR-based therapy will affect the treatment of HAE.

item.title: Vital Signs: Novo Nordisk's tussle with Eli Lilly changes venue
item.description: Everything is coming up roses for Novo Nordisk's oral Wegovy, even as investors hesitate to give the company any credit as it sets up a new, ex-US face-off against Eli Lilly.

item.title: Spotlight On: Pitch perfect pricing sets tone for Novo's big Wegovy Pill win in Q1
item.description: Novo Nordisk announced its first-quarter earnings today and was able to tout the record breaking launch of Wegovy Pill in the US market. Equally important, perhaps, was a suggestion that Novo will not — in the short term at least — have to compete with its rival Eli Lilly on price.

item.title: Spotlight On: Pfizer sees China as opportunity to close gap on obesity front-runners
item.description: As ex-US sales of obesity drugs come into sharper focus, Pfizer said Tuesday that it hopes to be competitive in the Chinese GLP-1 market through its in-licensed asset ecnoglutide.
